Lemma
[The Ambient Tangent Bundle Along a Submanifold]

↗ def:riemannian-metric ↗ def:induced-metric

For a Riemannian $(\widetilde M,\widetilde g)$ and smooth $F:M\to \widetilde M$, the pullback bundle $F^*T\widetilde M$, with fibre $T_{F(p)}\widetilde M$, has the smoothly varying fibre metric $\widetilde g_{F(p)}$. For an inclusion this is $T\widetilde M|_M$, containing the orthogonal splitting into tangent and normal spaces and the projections of Proposition 5.
Proof

↗ def:riemannian-metric \sketch In a pulled-back trivialization, the fibre metric is the coordinate representation of $\widetilde g$ evaluated at $F(p)$, hence smooth; symmetry and positivity are inherited fibrewise.

□
